subject: Regarding Methylkit for DNA methylation microarray data

messages.author: 3133746cf1f71532
messages.subject: Regarding Methylkit for DNA methylation microarray data
parts:
Hi,
I just want to know that can I use methylkit for the analysis of DNA methylation analysis by using DNA methylation microarray data e.g. Illumina Infinium Human DNA methylation 27/450. 

My input .txt file does not containn coverage (coverage column is missing), below I am giving dummy example.
chrBase   chr    base strand  freqC  freqT

1 chr21.9764539 chr21 9764539	R	0.1	0.7
2 chr21.9764513 chr21 9764513	R	0.2	0.8
3 chr21.9820622 chr21 9820622	R	0.1	0.6
4 chr21.9837545 chr21 9837545	R	0.4	0.9
5 chr21.9849022 chr21 9849022	R	0.1	0.4



Your suggestion can help me a lot.

Thanks
Nitish

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Regarding Methylkit for DNA methylation microarray data
parts:
Hi Nitish,
I think it is better you use methylumi or some specialised package designed for methylation arrays. methylKit is designed to be used for bilsulfite sequencing based methods.

Best,
Altuna
